# Chandras EDU

> Free engineering and professional courses with quizzes, progress tracking, and certificates. Part of the Chandra Shaker (chandrashaker.in) education brand.

Chandras EDU offers two course tracks: Academic engineering subjects for B.Tech students, and Professional job-readiness courses for working professionals. All content is free to read; login is required to save quiz progress and earn certificates.

## Academic

- [Computer Organization and Architecture](https://courses.chandrashaker.in/academic/coa/index.html): Number systems, logic gates, combinational and sequential circuits, CPU design, memory hierarchy, and I/O organization.
- [COA Unit 1 — Number Systems & Logic](https://courses.chandrashaker.in/academic/coa/unit1/index.html): Data types, complements, fixed/floating-point representation, binary codes, binary logic, storage registers, logic gates, and K-map representation.
- [COA Unit 2 — Combinational Logic](https://courses.chandrashaker.in/academic/coa/unit2/index.html): Combinational circuit analysis and design, binary adders and subtractors, multipliers, magnitude comparators, decoders, encoders, and multiplexers.
- [Digital Logic Design](https://courses.chandrashaker.in/academic/dld/index.html): Number systems and codes, error detection/correction, Boolean algebra, K-map minimization, combinational and sequential circuits, state machines, and PLDs.
- [DLD Unit 1 — Number Systems, Codes & Boolean Algebra](https://courses.chandrashaker.in/academic/dld/unit1/index.html): Binary/octal/decimal/hex conversion, fixed/floating-point representation, 1's/2's complement, parity and Hamming error correction codes, Boolean algebra theorems, canonical forms, and the seven basic logic gates.
- [DLD Unit 2 — Gate-Level Minimization (K-Maps)](https://courses.chandrashaker.in/academic/dld/unit2/index.html): 2/3/4-variable Karnaugh maps, SOP and POS simplification, don't-care conditions, and converting minimal expressions into NAND-NAND or NOR-NOR circuits.

## Professional

- [Generative AI: Zero to Job-Ready](https://courses.chandrashaker.in/professional/genai/index.html): A 20-module course covering GenAI foundations, prompt engineering, applied AI for developers/analysts/managers, RAG and agents, and career growth strategies.
